macMatch.offsetNote: “MAC difference ±N” compares MACs as numbers (same OUI): for routers/ONUs whose MACs differ by a few counts, e.g. ONU …50 and router …51, including across octet boundaries. The nearest ONU is chosen; ties or one ONU claimed by two sessions are flagged ambiguous. “-N octets” only matches the MAC prefix.
macMatch.summary: {{sessions}} active sessions · {{onus}} non-ZTE ONUs scanned · {{match}} match
macMatch.note: Only non-ZTE ONUs with an empty name (NA) are scanned. Apply writes the PPPoE username to the ONU Name and PPPoE fields. Ambiguous matches (several ONUs sharing a MAC prefix — usually the same vendor OUI) cannot be selected; reduce the octet strip or set the name manually.

pg_alerts.outageDesc: When many ONUs go down together, NMS looks for the fault point in the FTTH topology (ODP → ODC/JC → OTB) and sends one alert for that point, with a likely cause (power cut or fibre cut) and a location link. Requires ONUs linked to ODP ports in the FTTH menu.
pg_alerts.outageMinOnuHelp: ONUs down at one point before it counts as an outage (2–20).
pg_alerts.outageRatioHelp: For ODC/JC/OTB: most ONUs below it must be down (50–100).
pg_alerts.areaDesc: Alerts in an area go to its primary technician first (ONU's assigned technician → ODP → ODC/JC → OTB → OLT). Technicians without an area (admin/NOC) still receive every alert. Backup technicians are used for escalation.
pg_alerts.areaEmpty: No areas yet. Every technician receives every alert.
pg_alerts.areaPickBoth: Pick a technician and an area
pg_alerts.escDesc: If an incident is not accepted in time, NMS sends WhatsApp to the area's backup technician, then to admins. Incidents past the time-to-repair target get one reminder.
pg_alerts.escAckHelp: Wait before moving to the backup, then to admins (5–240).
pg_alerts.escTtrHelp: Reminder when an incident is still open after this many hours (1–72).
pg_alerts.maintDesc: Hold alerts and incidents during planned work. Choose all OLTs, one OLT, or one OTB/JC/ODC/ODP — only customers below it are held.
pg_alerts.maintEmpty: No maintenance scheduled in the last 7 days.
